claims.head: Stützle gets company tonight
claims.call: The Flyers’ L2 (Dvorak, Foerster and Barkey) spends at least 36% of its 5-on-5 time against the Senators’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Flyers keep sending Dvorak’s line (Dvorak, Foerster and Barkey) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Rick Tocchet has been giving this group the hard job of facing the other team’s top line. Tonight the Senators’ first line is Batherson, Stützle and Halliday.
claims.nums: At home: 36% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against first lines, about 25% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Rick Tocchet likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Senators’ first line.

notes.text: Jordan Spence has started killing penalties: on the ice for 39% of the team’s shorthanded time in 8 games, up from 4% last season.

The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 9 games cover only 20% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the lowest share in the league (a typical team: 46%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
David Jiříček has started playing on the power play: on the ice for 44% of the team’s power-play time in 7 games, up from 2% last season.

PHI.head: The Flyers have a hill to climb
PHI.body: Even though Philadelphia has home-ice advantage, Ottawa has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Flyers can pull it off if their penalty kill holds up.

OTT.head: Advantage, the Senators
OTT.body: Even though Philadelphia has home-ice advantage, Ottawa has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Flyers can make it interesting if their penalty kill holds up.

story.head: The Flyers are still looking for their first win
paras: The Flyers are still looking for their first win of the season, 0-6-3 through nine games. The Senators are 6-2-0. The Senators won the first meeting this season, 2-1 in Ottawa.
At home, Rick Tocchet likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Senators’ first line. Both teams play slow, low-event hockey.

items.text: The Senators have been without Jonas Johansson and William Eklund for several games, and have had to make do without Jake Sanderson all season. Linus Ullmark is expected to start.
The Flyers are newly without Owen Tippett, and have been without Cam York and Travis Konecny for several games.
Tim Stützle has seven goals in ten games against Philadelphia since 2023-24.
Drake Batherson is one goal from passing Radek Bonk for ninth on the Senators’ all-time goals list.
